style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Frosted Berry & Cone Wreath
style.toneOfVoice: Bring a touch of winter wonder into your home with this 60cm artificial frosted berry & cone wreath. Perfectly capturing the beauty of the season, it features a mix of frosted berries, pine cones, and lush greenery for a festive and natural look. The wreath is designed with lifelike foliage and delicately textured accents that evoke the charm of a fresh winter woodland. Its cool, frosted tones add a crisp, seasonal feel, making it an ideal statement piece for doors, mantels, or table displays. Measuring 60cm in diameter, it’s generously sized to create an inviting focal point without overwhelming your décor. Crafted from high-quality artificial materials, it provides lasting beauty and can be reused year after year. Perfect for bringing warmth, elegance, and a touch of winter magic to your home, this frosted berry & cone wreath is a timeless festive addition. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions. Wreath Width: W60cm. Wipe clean with a soft cloth.
